bumpRationale: Full closure of role-escalation findings C1/C2 (2026-07-03). Field-level RLS now locks UserProfile.app_role to the service role, and PendingChange approval fields (status/approver_*/approved_at) to the service role on update — so the raw Base44 SDK can no longer set a role or forge an approval. Onboarding's initial role assignment moves to a new service-role backend function provisionOnboardingProfile (founder-only ADMIN; joiners land PENDING for admin approval), since the field lock blocks direct client writes. Shared rules in src/lib/authorization/onboardingProvision.js, unit-tested. REQUIRES ordered owner deploy: deploy governRoleChange + provisionOnboardingProfile FIRST, then the schema (FLS) — see docs/security-role-governance-remediation.md. All 271 tests pass; lint clean; RLS validation green (31 entities); release gate green (23/23); typecheck clean; build succeeds.

architecture.runtime: browser (client-side only; no application server) + Base44 backend functions for privileged mutations
architecture.enforcementBoundary: base44 Row-Level Security (entity + field-level RLS) in base44/entities/*.jsonc + service-role backend functions in base44/functions/*
architecture.language: JavaScript / JSX (type-checked via jsconfig); Deno TypeScript for backend functions

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
